label: lem:mvt
title: Mean Value Theorem
statement: Let $a < b$ and let $G$ be continuous on $[a,b]$ with derivative $G'(x)$ at every $x \in (a,b)$. Then there exists $c \in (a,b)$ with $G'(c) = \frac{G(b) - G(a)}{b - a}$. This is \texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}.
proof: This is the classical Mean Value Theorem; we invoke \texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}.
